# cocode.dk - Babak Bandpey

> Babak Bandpey is an AI consultant in Copenhagen, Denmark. He helps companies put AI to work, and he builds what he recommends himself. cocode.dk is one person; the site shows what he has built.

Services: advice on where AI is worth using, AI agents that carry out real work, and automation of repetitive tasks. The site is in Danish.

## Featured work

- [SwanReady](https://sr.cocode.dk): His own product. An AI agent that helps manufacturers apply for the Nordic Swan Ecolabel: it finds the product category, walks through the requirements one at a time, tracks the documentation and writes the application summary. [Two-minute story](https://swanready.cocode.dk).
- [Weather](https://weather.cocode.dk): Android weather app for any location.
- [Metrologist](https://measure.cocode.dk): Android app that measures real objects from a single photo.
- [Parvaz](https://parvaz.cocode.dk): Android app for getting around internet censorship in Iran.
- [claude-email](https://claude-email.cocode.dk): Hand a task to an AI agent by e-mail; it replies when the work is done.
- [lpterapi.dk](https://lpterapi.dk): Website for a couples therapist.

## More apps

## Client sites and AI tools

- [Venus Høreklinik](https://klinikvenus.dk), [Nick Autoteknik](https://nick-autoteknik.dk), Klinik for Manuel Terapi, Unity Foundation
- [Jev Bench](https://jev-bench.cocode.dk): an open workbench for measuring how fast and how accurately AI models classify, with repeatable datasets and downloadable results.
- [zjm-rag](https://rag.cocode.dk): finds the file that holds the answer; zg searches, Jev ranks, and an LLM answers from those files only, citing their paths.
- [graph-loop](https://graph-loop.cocode.dk): unattended AI agent loops. MCP servers for calendars, Teams Planner and memory. [FITS.DK](https://fits.dk): a compliance platform, more than 3000 hours of work.

## For AI agents in the browser

The page registers WebMCP tools (`document.modelContext`): `list_works`, `get_services`, `get_about`, `get_contact`, `go_to_section` and `draft_inquiry`. `draft_inquiry` opens a prefilled e-mail to Babak in the visitor's mail app; nothing is sent until the visitor presses send.
